canonical_repository.name: 7guard-io/7ya.io
canonical_repository.role: canonical governance, review and long-term source-control plane

principles: A plan is not an outcome

active_production.version_label_policy: AppDeploy vNN labels are rolling display labels; use immutable snapshot ids for receipts and provenance.

runtime_qa.e2e_runner: not reported by current AppDeploy QA (e2e_tests=null)

source_alignment.rule: Do not claim GitHub main is deployment-identical until recovered runtime source and binary resources pass parity review.
source_alignment.next_gate: complete text/binary parity, compare recovered runtime against the older root application, then choose the canonical GitHub application tree before any GitHub-driven cutover

deployment.rollback: Use immutable AppDeploy snapshot ids from get_app_versions/apply_app_version; preserve prior working snapshots until the replacement passes runtime and route gates.

historical_control_planes.warning: Do not cut production back to this project unless an explicit rollback/cutover plan is approved and current AppDeploy production has been independently compared.

ci.github_actions_state: may be blocked before checkout by organization billing/account state
ci.interpretation: No workflow run is not a code PASS and not a code FAIL. Never claim CI passed when no job executed.

dns_policy.rule: Do not change nameservers; preserve all mail-related MX and TXT records.

privacy_boundary: No private family, medical, legal or financial information
No raw private emails, credentials, tokens or account codes
No operational security methods or protected case information
